title_en: [Graduate School] List of Master's and Doctoral Students Expected to Complete Coursework or Graduate in August 2026
summary: The department has published the list of graduate students expected to complete coursework or receive a degree in August 2026, and students must check the list and submit any required forms or corrections by the stated deadlines. Doctoral degree candidates must also complete a mandatory Ministry of Education survey, and students who wish to change their English name on the degree certificate must apply by 23 July 2026.
applies_to: Master's, doctoral and integrated master's-doctoral students expected to complete coursework (수료) or receive a degree in August 2026, and any student who believes they should be, or should not be, on the list. Certain items apply only to specific groups: the non-completion confirmation applies only to students contacted by telephone; the completion deferral request applies only to students on the completion list who do not wish to complete this semester; the Ministry of Education survey applies only to expected doctoral degree recipients; the English name change applies to anyone who wishes to change their English name.

steps: Check whether you meet the completion/graduation requirements, using the academic guide distributed at admission and the self-check checklist in the FAQ (자주묻는질문) posts on the academic board.

Check whether your name appears on the list of expected completion and degree recipients (attachment 'Completion and Degree Conferment Candidates' (수료 및 학위수여 예정자)). If you believe you are completing this semester, you must confirm your name is on the list.
If the department office contacts you by telephone, submit the Non-Completion Confirmation (미수료 확인서) form (attachment 1) by Thursday, 23 July 2026.
If you are on the completion list but do not wish to complete this semester, submit the Completion Deferral Request (수료유예원) form (attachment 2) by Thursday, 23 July 2026.
If you have taken courses from other departments or undergraduate courses and have not submitted an approval application for them, submit it now.

If you have any irregularity (e.g. you wish to defer but are on the list, you believe you qualify but are not on the list, you believe you do not meet the requirements but are on the list, or you are a graduation candidate not on the list), tell the staff member in charge at the department office.
If you are an expected degree recipient and find an error in the list, contact the department administrative office by Wednesday, 22 July 2026.

Expected doctoral degree recipients only: complete the Ministry of Education statistical survey following the manual (attachments 4-1/4-2), then email the survey completion certificate to the staff member in charge by Friday, 7 August 2026.

Check your English name on the MySNU login screen. If you wish to change it, apply by Thursday, 23 July 2026 via MySNU → Academic Information System (학사정보시스템) → Change of Academic Status (학적변동) → Application (신청) → Correction of Academic Record Entries (학적부기재사항정정), attaching a copy of your passport or alien registration card.
If you submitted a Non-Completion Confirmation or Completion Deferral Request, register for the next semester (do not reduce your enrolment to 0 credits).
translation:
[Graduate School] ★ List of Master's and Doctoral Students Expected to Complete Coursework or Graduate in August 2026

※ You must check whether you meet the requirements for completion of coursework (수료) or graduation, using the academic guide distributed at admission and the checklists in the FAQ (자주묻는질문) posts on the academic board.

1. Expected Completion of Coursework

A. No separate application for completion is required. Students in the master's or doctoral programme who have registered for 4 or more semesters and earned the credits required for completion, and students in the integrated master's-doctoral programme who have registered for 6 or more semesters and earned the credits required for completion, are reviewed for completion. Therefore, if you believe this is your completion semester, you must check that your name is on the list.

B. Non-Completion Confirmation (미수료 확인서): Students required to submit it will be notified by telephone. They must submit the Non-Completion Confirmation (see attachment) by Thursday, 23 July 2026.

C. List of expected completion students: see the attachment 'Completion and Degree Conferment Candidates' (수료 및 학위수여 예정자). (Note: this list file does not appear among the attachments listed in the notice and its content was not read.)
※ If you are on the expected completion list but do not wish to complete this semester, please submit the Completion Deferral Request (수료유예원) (see attachment) by Thursday, 23 July 2026. If we do not hear from you by the deadline, it will be assumed that there are no issues and the process will proceed.

★ (Must read) Important! ★
1. Although the list of expected completion/graduation students has been posted as attached, students may be removed from or added to the list depending on the department office's review of completion/graduation requirements, and changes may occur.
※ A final review is in progress, including whether approval applications for courses taken in other departments (or undergraduate courses) have been submitted and whether completion requirements are met.
Therefore, students must also check the academic guide and the completion self-check checklist under Academic Board – FAQ (자주 묻는 질문).
2. If you have taken courses in other departments (or undergraduate courses) and have not submitted an approval application for them, you must submit it now.
3. Anyone with a special situation must inform the staff member in charge at the department office. This includes: you are on this semester's completion list but wish to defer completion; you believe you qualify for completion but are not on the list; you believe you do not meet the completion requirements but are on the list; or you are a graduation candidate but are not on the list. (The contact details are in the original notice.)

D. Notes for non-completion / expected completion students
If you submit a Non-Completion Confirmation or a Completion Deferral Request, you will exceed the standard number of semesters and must register for the next semester (3 credits or fewer: pay half of tuition; 4 credits or more: pay full tuition). Please note that a student who has exceeded the standard number of semesters and cancels course registration down to 0 credits will be expelled for non-registration.
Students exceeding the standard number of semesters: (enrolled) master's and doctoral students from the 5th semester; (enrolled) integrated master's-doctoral students from the 9th semester.
※ If you neither register for courses nor take a leave of absence, you will be expelled.
You cannot graduate or complete coursework while on leave of absence.
Integrated master's-doctoral students pay full tuition up to the 8th semester.

D. Reference: Thesis submission deadline – within 4 years after completion of master's coursework; within 6 years after completion of doctoral coursework.
※ You may graduate by passing the thesis review within the submission deadline. Registration as a research student (fee: 200,000 KRW) is required in the semester in which you apply for thesis review.

Requirements table:
- Number of registrations: Master's 4–8; Doctoral 4–12; Integrated 6–16.
- Minimum credits: Master's 24 or more; Doctoral 36 or more; Integrated 60 or more.
- Of which, graduate courses of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) (including Module Seminar (모듈세미나)): Master's 9 credits or more; Doctoral 12 credits or more; Integrated 21 credits or more.
- From 2022 entrants: one research ethics course is required (a maximum of 3 credits is recognised). * Related notice: a link ('클릭!!') is given in the original notice; its content was not read.
- Grades: GPA for all courses and for major courses must each be 3.0 or higher (on a 4.3 scale).

2. Expected Degree Recipients

A. List of expected degree recipients: see the attachment 'Completion and Degree Conferment Candidates' (수료 및 학위수여 예정자) (not read; see note above).
※ If you find any error in the list, contact the department administrative office by Wednesday, 22 July 2026. If we do not hear from you by the deadline, it will be assumed that there are no issues and the process will proceed.

B. Ministry of Education statistical survey: Participate in the survey following the manual in Attachment 4, then submit the survey completion certificate by email to the staff member in charge by Friday, 7 August 2026. (The email address is in the original notice.)
※ Applies only to expected doctoral degree recipients. Participation is mandatory, not optional.

C. Checking and changing your English name
Your English name (viewable on your MySNU login screen) will be printed on your degree certificate (diploma) at graduation.
Refer to the attachment 'Guide to Changing the English Name in Student Records' (학생 학적상 영문성명 변경신청 안내) (this attachment does not appear among the listed attachments and its content was not read). If you wish to change your English name, apply by Thursday, 23 July 2026.
※ How to apply (enrolled students, completed students and graduates alike): MySNU → Academic Information System (학사정보시스템) → Change of Academic Status (학적변동) → Application (신청) → Correction of Academic Record Entries (학적부기재사항정정)
※ You may apply for an English name change by attaching a copy of your passport or alien registration card.
※ Your Korean and English names are printed on the degree certificate (diploma), and degree certificates cannot be reissued.

3. Reference
- Certificates of Completion and Degree Certificates can be issued from the afternoon of the degree conferment ceremony (via MySNU).

4. Enquiries
- Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff member's name and email address are given in the original notice.
